summary: Immatics N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, reporting the completion of an underwritten public offering of 15,535,100 ordinary shares, including full exercise of the underwriters' option for 2,589,814 shares, and pre-funded warrants to purchase 4,315,304 ordinary shares at $0.001 per share. The offering was conducted under an F-3 shelf registration statement with Jefferies LLC, Jefferies GmbH, Leerink Partners LLC, and Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. as underwriters. Net proceeds of approximately $161.1 million were raised for pipeline R&D, manufacturing, commercialization, and working capital. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; no premium, target, or activist element is present.
